extension.summary: Pokrocily vyhledavac filmu a serialu pro Kodi s integraci Webshare.cz
Advanced movie & TV search for Kodi with Webshare.cz integration
extension.description:
RichMovie je pokrocily vyhledavac filmu a serialu pro Kodi. Nehostuje zadny obsah – pouze hleda dostupne soubory na Webshare.cz podle toho, co tam nekdo z internetu nasdilel.
Hlavni funkce:
• Rychle vyhledavani s metadaty z TMDb (plakaty, popisy, hodnoceni)
• Analyza streamu (MI2) – automaticke rozpoznani kvality, audia a titulku
• Automaticka lokalizace – prednostni vyber ceskeho dabingu a titulku
• Zapamatovani jazykovych preferenci pro kazdy titul zvlast
• Historie sledovani a Pokracovat ve sledovani
• Kolekce – tematicke seznamy filmu (Vanoce, Marvel, Studio Ghibli…)
• Next-Up – automaticke pokracovani na dalsi epizodu serialu
• Integrace RichSubtitles – ceske titulky z Titulky.com
• Trendy a nejlepe hodnocene filmy/serialy
RichMovie je volnocasovy projekt od Richieho – zdarma, pro rodinu a pratele.

RichMovie is an advanced movie and TV search add-on for Kodi. It does not host any content – it only searches for files available on Webshare.cz.
Key features:
• Fast search with TMDb metadata (posters, descriptions, ratings)
• Stream analysis (MI2) – automatic detection of quality, audio and subtitles
• Auto-localization – preferred Czech dubbing and subtitle selection
• Per-title audio/subtitle preference memory
• Watch history and Continue watching
• Collections – curated movie lists (Christmas, Marvel, Studio Ghibli…)
• Next-Up – automatic next episode for TV series
• RichSubtitles integration – Czech subtitles from Titulky.com
• Trending and top-rated movies/TV shows
RichMovie is a hobby project by Richie – free, for family and friends.
extension.changelog:
v3.4.3 – Defense-in-depth proti TMDb partial-detail cache poisoning (Lost incident 2026-04-30): • tmdb_client.tv_details rejectuje server-side partial payloady (chybi `seasons` nebo obsahuje `_partial_from` marker) — nezapise je do lokalni disk cache, vraci payload caller-i pro detekci. • Novy public `cache_evict(key)` helper na TMDb klientu. • plugin._tv_seasons rozlisuje partial vs. legitimate empty seasons; partial → evict lokalni cache + modal „TMDb vratilo neuplna data, zkuste znovu“; legit empty → modal „TMDb nema zadne sezony pro tento serial“. • Server-side fix v Gate (migration 0006 + service.fetch_or_cache partial-as-miss) je primary defense; addon-side je defense-in-depth pro prechodne okno + budouci regrese. Plan: Handoff/session_2026-04-30_tmdb_partial_cache_poisoning.md.
v3.4.2 – Phase 9 batch 2/3/4: dalsich 14 modulu zmigrovano na richmovie_logging pipeline. Stream resolvery (youtube, sosac, sktorrent, stream), HTTP backbone (webshare, fastshare), UI/files (helpers, local_files, collections, downloads, localization), plus 51 plain [RichMovie] call sites v plugin.py. Backwards-compat kodi.log prefixy zachovany pres XBMCFormatter acronym map. Subsystem-prefix calls v plugin.py ([RichMovie/Fastshare], [RichMovie/Gate] atd.) zustavaji direct xbmc.log — Phase 9 batch 5+ je migruje do svych modulu. Engine.py pouziva plugin._log_event delegaci, nepotrebuje migraci.
v3.4.1 – Phase 9 batch 1: 8 modulu zmigrovano na richmovie_logging pipeline (gate, ai_client, csfd, csfd_client, csfd_browser, gate_transport, mediainfo_client, search_client). Backwards-compat kodi.log prefixy [RichMovie/X] zachovany pres XBMCFormatter acronym mapping (CSFD/AI/MI/TMDb/WS/FS/RCAI/etc.). Drobne zmeny: [RichMovie/GateT] -> [RichMovie/Gate/Transport], [RichMovie/MI-Gate] -> [RichMovie/MI/Gate] (jasnejsi hierarchie). Vsechny migrovane events nyni tecou do user_logs telemetry alongside kodi.log. Helper make_legacy_logger() pro budouci dalsi migrace.
v3.4.0 – Always-on per-user log telemetry (enterprise grade): • Novy logger pipeline (richmovie_logging.py) s RedactingFilter (passwords/wst/FASTSHARE/Bearer/email/PAT scrubbed at ingress) + XBMCHandler (Elementum-style xbmc.log bridge) + RichLogHandler (SQLite WAL persist). • SQLite WAL buffer (richmovie_log_buffer.py) crash-resilient, multi-process safe (BEGIN IMMEDIATE + busy_timeout=5000), 50k row / 10MB hard cap. • Drainer thread v service_warm.py (non-daemon, .stop(timeout=3.0) honors Kodi 5s force-kill window) batches 100 events / 200KB / 30s, NDJSON+gzip POST to Gate /v1/user_logs/batch s exponential backoff 30s-5min. • Shutdown sentinel: pri abortRequested ship last batch s timeout=1.5s, fall-through na disk persist (rows survive Python interpreter death pres SQLite WAL fsync na commit). • Default ON (always-on per family use-case), per-user kill-switch v Gate admin (users.diagnostic_logs_enabled). • DEBUG sampling default OFF (~10x volume); admin enable per-user via debug_logs_enabled. • Server: PostgreSQL user_logs table (BIGSERIAL, TIMESTAMPTZ, JSONB, append-only via reject_mutation), 4 indexes (composite + 2 partial WHERE level>=WARNING + source/level), 30d retention via existing _retention_cleanup_loop. • Admin UI: /gate/admin/logs Jinja2 page s filter (user/level/source/hours/limit) + color-coded table + SSE tail-f live mode. GDPR erasure: POST /gate/admin/logs/forget/{user} (anonymize, NOT DELETE per append-only).
v3.3.0 – Zero external dependencies (enterprise grade): • Vsechny pure-Python zavislosti (requests, urllib3, certifi, idna, chardet) vendorovane v resources/lib/vendor/. Instalace nestahuje nic z mirrors.kodi.tv ani 3rd-party repu — vse je v hlavnim ZIPu. • Drop <import> pro script.module.requests, script.module.stream.resolver (dead code), inputstream.adaptive (mel runtime fallback). Zustava jen xbmc.python (Kodi runtime) a service.subtitles.richsubtitles (z naseho repa). • Resi to bracha-style instalacni pady kde Kodi nedokaze rozresit zavislosti pres mirror.kodi.tv (DNS / region block / starsi Kodi mismatch). • Hlavni ZIP narostl o ~3 MB (vendor libs + LICENSES). Trade-off: zero install-time risk pro vsechny budouci uzivatele.
v3.1.0-beta.1 – AI Personalizovana doporuceni (overnight autonomous build): • Nove menu „Doporuceni presne pro Vas“ pod „Hledat serial“ – per-user AI doporuceni generovana v noci (Claude Opus pres RCAI, quality=high). • Rich psychology telemetrie: pause/seek/speed/drop_point/binge_session/audio-sub-switch/source-quality preference, multi-persona detekce per zarizeni a casovem oknem (rodinne ucty), per-startup atomic batch sync do Gate. • Nove moduly addonu: richmovie_telemetry.py, richmovie_player_hook.py (xbmc.Player subclass), richmovie_recommendations.py (UI + Gate klient). • Backend: vlastni richmovie-postgres container (port 5435, izolovany od richtodo/richclaude), 5 novych tabulek (user_watch_events, user_search_events, user_taste_profile, user_recommendations, user_recommendation_feedback) plne Rich* DB Standards-compliant (TIMESTAMPTZ, JSONB, partial indexes, append-only audit, soft delete). • GDPR: „Smazat AI historii“ v Settings – soft delete recs, hard delete taste, anonymize append-only event log.
v3.0.3 – opravy + UX vylepseni: • Fastshare crowdsource cache fix: bulk_lookup nyni nachazi cached probes (predtim 32% Fastshare zaznamu nedostupnych kvuli double `fs:` prefix bugu). • Info panel pod posterem: pridan plot, runtime, rating, votes, genre, cast, director, originalni titulek (predtim „Nejsou dostupne zadne informace“). • Stream details: audio/subtitle jazyky a video resolution se predavaji do Kodi `streamdetails` – skin Estuary zobrazuje vlajky/ikony. • Badge rozsireni: SK dab, SK tit, EN tit (predtim jen CZ dab, CZ tit, EN dab). • LabelFormatter: kvalita zobrazena bez mezer uvnitr `[]` zavorek.
v3.0.2 – oprava UX: pri auto-search z TMDb klikni (TV tipy / Top filmy / Trendy) se behem MI2 wait okna ted zobrazuji rotujici tipy (predtim jen busy spinner). Manualni keyboard search uz fungoval spravne.
v3.0.1 – oprava ZIP archivu (POSIX paths) pro spolehlivou Kodi instalaci na Linux/Android. Funkcionalita beze zmeny vuci 3.0.0.
v3.0.0 – Major architektonicke prepracovani: thin-client. Addon je nyni cista Kodi GUI vrstva, vsechen scraping, MediaInfo probe i TMDb proxy bezi na centralnim NAS Gate (~52 MB ze 129 MB).
• Streaming: BYOC (Bring Your Own Credentials) – soubory jdou primo z Webshare/Fastshare CDN na zarizeni uzivatele, NAS bytes nepretece. • CSFD TV tipy: 3 dny dopredu (dnes/zitra/poprzitri), pre-loaded TMDb metadata (poster, rating, overview, runtime). Klik < 1.5s. • A.I. doporuceni: Claude Opus pres RichClaudeAI tenant (vystridal OpenAI), centralizovany rate limit + telemetrie. • Sdilena crowdsource MediaInfo cache: prvni uzivatel probre stream, ostatni dostanou metadata zdarma. Gate eviduje 700+ unikatnich streamu. • Vyhledavani: vystupy v jedne linii (tabular zarovnani kvality + velikosti), WS/FS prefix u multi-source, MI2 probe blocking 60s pred renderem (zadne raw vystupy). • Fail-fast: zadne legacy scrape fallbacky – zdroje volaji Gate, na chybu cista chybova hlaska. • Spolehlivost: rate limity per uzivatel (search 60/h, probe 300/h), memory limit 1 GB, healthchecky. • Engine: search/filter heuristiky (banned_keys, year_whitelist, ser_title_variants, title_penalty, runtime match) zustavaji v addonu (pul roku ladeni), ale orchestrace pres Gate.
